authorization: User requested LANG_ADD plus WD_REPLACE on the fixed R_KEEP evaluation. New combination only; three own-pool GREEDY initializers followed by three R_KEEP fits.
candidate_change: W0 + fixed language-first atom + legacy webdriver-state atom - old webdriver EQ:True; keep complete old language-length family.
family_policy: Reuse original field family; both frozen grammar polarities; no duplicated evidence or forced inclusion.

objective.macro_weights: equal training config weights; within config equal represented environment weights; within config/environment equal admitted attack-stage weights

GREEDY_OR.add_step: highest strictly positive objective improvement subject to set clean budget, support and complexity; evaluate final coverage at each step and retain best feasible visited model
GREEDY_OR.prune: delete in lexical order only if all constraints remain feasible and objective does not decrease

COLUMN_GENERATION.condition: finite search insufficient and user authorizes extension before affected outer access

rationale.alpha: 5% is a coarse empirical budget resolvable as 1-4 training clean alarms in current LOEO folds, not a population guarantee
rationale.lambda: 0.01 objective cost per singleton discourages redundant rules without demanding broad attack coverage
rationale.complexity: at most six clauses keeps interpretation reviewable; all choices fixed before outcome ranking
rationale.support: three complete triads and two true attack triads permit narrow specialists while recording limited batch independence

duplicates.canonical_positive_literal: use row.direct_OR_deviation_polarity; canonical negative uses its opposite; U unchanged
duplicates.equal_domain_requirement: same R01 app_android_major or system_android_major profile; reject alias merge if value/availability/reason domain differs

retention.objective: Positive additional weighted (semantic signal group, train attack) coverage; preserve initial attack detection and original whole-set constraints.
retention.operations: Add only; no removal, replacement, or sparse pruning of the saved initialization.
retention.historical_code_note: Current retention math and ordering match B01. Existing later timeout-status fix reports TIME_LIMIT_FEASIBLE or FAILED_FIT instead of an ordinary completion; no new change this round.

execution_order: Three own-pool sparse train-only fits, then three retention fits using matching saved sparse model/encoder. Only retention models produce held-out predictions.
metrics: Original full-denominator OOF metrics; paired comparisons to BASE, LANG_ADD and WD_REPLACE; descriptive interaction (combo-LANG_ADD)-(WD_REPLACE-BASE). Unknown or failed outcomes stay explicit.
exposure: Already exposed retrospective development; no independent confirmation or causal population interaction claim.
failure_policy: Preserve every attempted fit and partial prediction; stop after failure, no automatic retry or semantic/budget relaxation.
